pages.text: $(l)Infusion$()$(li)Darkstar Compound must be crafted into an ingot before it can be duplicated in the Dynatos system.$(li)Add more simulation chambers to make more insanium. They only crash when you look inside, so don't.

$(l)Enchanting$()$(li)Apply conflicting enchants via Mass Enchanting first, then use Enchant Applicator for non-conflicting enchants; super enchanted items can be used as sources.$(li)Last Stand can be duplicated up to level 30 using Bibliocraft, avoiding the need for many super-enchantments.
$(l)Last Stand$()$(li)One piece of armor with Last Stand 1 + enough XP levels lets you survive indefinitely; higher levels reduce XP use.
$(l)Focus Lens$()$(li)Passive crafting of Recursion Focus Lens can be done by auto-crafting Recursion Fragment Terra, bypassing Garnet-based recipes.
